description: Pipeline baseline with recoverable tool-argument errors and an explicit final-answer phase after at most 12 investigation calls.

judge.method: Claim-level comparison against private reference claims and observed tool evidence
judge.scoring: weighted claim coverage: supported=1, partial=0.5, missing/contradicted=0; not a strict RL reward

dataset.purpose: pipeline smoke test and regression baseline; not final benchmark

rollout.environment_policy: reuse verified immutable images; fresh stateless sandbox per tool operation
rollout.protocol: json-action-v1; flat tool args accepted; missing terminal object braces repaired only after natural stop, counted and raw output retained

tracking.name: baseline-qwen35-4b-generated-dev-v2
tracking.upload_failure_policy: preserve local results; mark tracking failure

success_criteria.required: Live model generation, real Modal tool execution, valid grader output, W&B run URL and durable per-task records
success_criteria.missing_results: report as unresolved; never silently drop from coverage

notes: No secret values belong in this file.
Snapshot this config into each run; use a new experiment ID for changed settings.
Do not silently substitute SWE-QA-Pro retrieval/demo runs for these generated tool tasks.
provenance.change_reason: v1 exposed terminal handling of recoverable path errors and investigation loops; v2 returns tool errors to the model and reserves answer synthesis.
